what: Round 1 cold spec-judge returned ALIGNED true but left an open marker on the producer-side negative companion: its first Then asserted the criterion stays a graded dimension without scoping that assertion to the ground its Given establishes, so it read as unconditional against a standing sibling whose narrower Given supplies a boolean twin. Passing only under the specialization clause is not the same as being right.
rule: a scenario's Then must be scoped to the ground its own Given establishes, so no sibling with a narrower Given can be read as contradicted.
sweep: applied the rule to all four added scenarios; the other three already carry the scoping (two in the Given, one in the Then). Single instance, corrected at the Given rather than the Then so the positive assertion survives.

rule: a criterion's classifier is stated monadically — the single criterion read against the output — and never as a comparison between candidate dimensions.
